fields.name: vehicles
fields.tooltip: The cars traffic picks from, by weight. Every entry is prewarmed maxActive times when a level binds, so a long list costs memory, not hitches.

fields.name: maxActive
fields.tooltip: Cars on the road at once.

fields.name: spawnSpacing
fields.tooltip: Least gap between a new car and the nearest one already on the road, metres — rolled per spawn inside this band.

fields.name: spawnAheadSeconds
fields.tooltip: A new car appears this many seconds of the ship's travel ahead of it, so it is past the fog at any speed. Clamped to the built road.

fields.name: minSpawnAhead
fields.tooltip: Never spawn closer than this ahead of the ship. When the built road does not reach this far, the spawn waits.

fields.name: despawnBehind
fields.tooltip: A car goes back to the pool once it is this far behind the ship.

fields.name: noSpawnNearEnd
fields.tooltip: No new car once the ship has this much track or less left. Cars already on the road drive on; none ever spawns on the final run-up.

fields.name: visibleRange
fields.tooltip: When HIT HYPERSPACE clears the road, cars this close ahead of the ship explode (harmlessly); the ones further off just vanish.

fields.name: speedBand
fields.tooltip: Cruise speed of a car toward the ship, rolled once per spawn inside this band.

fields.name: lateralSpeed
fields.tooltip: How fast a car changes lane, metres per second across the road.

fields.name: avoidLookahead
fields.tooltip: How far down the road a car plans round ramps and laser gates, metres. Long enough for the lane change to finish: at the slowest car speed it must cover the widest move at the lateral speed above.

fields.name: avoidMargin
fields.tooltip: Clearance a car keeps from a ramp's side or a laser's beam and emitters, metres, on top of its own half width.

fields.name: edgeMargin
fields.tooltip: Clearance a car keeps from an edge with no wall, metres, on top of its own half width. Cars never fall.

fields.name: explosionScale
fields.tooltip: Size of a car's explosion, as a multiple of the ship's own (GameSettings explosion). The textures, lifetime and particle count are the ship's.

fields.name: prefab
fields.tooltip: The car's model. Instantiated under the pooled car with its transform reset and every collider stripped.

fields.name: weight
fields.tooltip: Share of the picks, relative to the other entries (they need not sum to anything).

fields.name: scale
fields.tooltip: Size of the model. The Cyberpunk air-traffic cars are about 5 m long at 1; ~3.5 makes them as long as the ship.

fields.name: yawOffset
fields.tooltip: Yaw that turns the model's nose down its own +Z. The Cyberpunk models are built along X and want -90.

fields.name: hoverHeight
fields.tooltip: Height of the car above the road, along the track's up.

fields.name: halfLength
fields.tooltip: Half the car's length along the track, for contact.

fields.name: halfWidth
fields.tooltip: Half the car's width across the track, for contact and for the gap it needs past an obstacle.

fields.name: height
fields.tooltip: The car's height above its hover line, for contact: a ship flying higher than hover + this clears it.
